writeup: Woot has Sunnydaze Decor's bronze Decorative Scroll gazing ball stand (model ZIB-9391, UPC 810164261939) for $15.99. It is a powder-coated steel single stand that holds 10-12 inch globes about 10 inches off the ground. Sunnydaze Decor's own site lists the matching Bronze / 1 variant, SKU ZIB-9391, at $36.95 and shows it in stock. That is 56 percent below the verified store price and saves about $21. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
